Product Features

  • [Plenty of storage space]: This modern sideboard features a single-door cabinet with concealed shelves and provides generous storage space for all your household items.
  • [Plenty of storage space]: The compartments behind the doors and the spacious drawers provide ample storage space for multimedia devices and accessories. The top shelf offers enough space for a TV.
  • [High-Quality Construction]: This sideboard is made of 15mm E1 chipboard and is built to last. The front of the furniture, including the doors and drawer front, has a high-gloss effect finish that adds a touch of modern elegance. The rest of the body is finished with a matte texture that creates a stylish contrast. The sturdy construction ensures durability and longevity.
  • [Versatile Functionality]: Designed for versatility, this sideboard is a practical addition to any room. It's an excellent choice for the living room, bedroom, hallway, or even a small dining area. In addition, it can serve as a stylish TV stand or as an office tea room cabinet, which provides functionality and enhances the aesthetics of your space.
  • [Easy assembly and delivery]: This sideboard comes with clear installation instructions to guide you through the assembly process. The delivery is made in two packages, which ensures safe transport and easy handling. Once assembled, this sideboard immediately enhances the décor of any home or office, making it a chic and functional statement piece.
  • 【Large Storage & Durable Material】This 160cm wooden accent cabinet is made of chipboard with excellent stability and an easy-to-clean surface. Features 2 doors, 2 open storage spaces, 4 drawers and 1 glass partition to store various items such as necessities, plates and cups. The top can also be used to display your books, vases and photo frames to decorate your living room. Kitchen / Bedroom / Entrance
  • Easy installation – Our sideboard is easy to install with the detailed brochure and the included graphic instructions. All that is required to clean the sideboard's high-quality surface materials, which are waterproof, heat-resistant, and dustproof, is a paper towel. Easy cleaning.
  • 【Multifunctional for Home Use】This sideboard and storage cabinet from buffets is the ultimate eye-catcher for your living room or kitchen. It features a straightforward silhouette and a neutral, solid finish for an understated appearance without losing fashion, which is perfect for your home! If you want, you can also turn this sideboard into a stylish kitchen buffet or TV stand in your bedroom.
  • LED Atmosphere Lighting: Equipped with LED light strips controlled by mobile phone app, which can adjust the lighting according to different scenes and easily create a warm and cool living room atmosphere.
  • USB Power Delivery: Included is a 5V 2A USB cable (USB port not included) for connecting to TVs, computers, power banks, and more. Safe and practical for indoor use.

Descriptions

LED App Application and Manager:

1. iOS and Android systems can download the "LotusLantern" app by scanning the QR code. To do this, open a browser or other tool with the "Scan QR Code" feature and scan the "LotusLantern" QR code (the QR code is in the user manual). 2. Click on the LotusLantern app icon to open the app page. 3. If Bluetooth is not enabled in the app interface, you will see the message "An application wants to enable the Bluetooth function of this device". Click 'Allow.' 4. Simply stick the light strip to a clean, dry surface with the self-adhesive backing. Use the included tape to improve adhesion. Please test the LED light strips before installation and install them carefully. If you have any questions, please contact us.
